newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks rise at open, pleased by rate news.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks rise at open, pleased by rate news.

text.p: U.S. stocks were still celebrating yesterday's decision by Federal Reserve policy makers to leave short-term interest rates alone, pushing higher in early trading on Wednesday.
The Dow Jones industrial average rose about 30 points to 7334, after rallying 74.58 points late in Tuesday's session.

The technology-heavy Nasdaq composite also surged, rising nearly 13 points to 1377, helped by strength in the technology sector and a steep gain in Dell Computer Corp. Dell was trading up nearly eight points at 107-5/8 after the company posted stronger-than expected first quarter results.
